meta.title: Multilingual TanStack Start Starter
meta.description: An open-source TanStack Start template with locale-prefixed routes, hreflang, JSON-LD, MDX blog content, and a responsive landing page.
meta.keywords: tanstack start, i18n template, multilingual website, react ssr, seo starter, mdx blog

hero.title: Ship multilingual sites
hero.description: Localized routes, canonical URLs, hreflang alternates, structured data, and a ready-made design system. Clone it, change one config file, and start writing content.

features.title: What is included
features.description: Everything a content site needs before you write the first line of product code.

items.title: Locale-aware routing
items.description: An optional locale segment keeps one route tree per page while the default locale stays clean and unprefixed.

items.title: Search-engine ready
items.description: Per-page canonical links, hreflang alternates with x-default, Open Graph, Twitter cards, and JSON-LD structured data.

items.title: Message catalogs
items.description: Typed JSON namespaces with English fallback, loadable per route so non-default locales stay out of the main bundle.

items.title: Blog content collection
items.description: MDX posts validated by Zod, compiled at build time, with locale-aware slugs and related-post links.

items.title: Configure
items.description: Set your name, URL, and email in src/site.config.ts.

items.title: Write copy
items.description: Edit the JSON catalogs in src/messages for each locale.

items.title: Publish
items.description: Add MDX posts in content/blogs and run pnpm build.

items.question: How do I add a new language?
items.answer: Create a folder in src/messages with the same JSON namespaces, then add the native label to NATIVE_LANGUAGE_LABELS. Routes and the sitemap pick it up automatically.

items.question: Why is English not prefixed?
items.answer: The default locale uses clean URLs like /blog. Visiting /en/blog redirects there with a 301 so there is only one canonical URL per page.

items.question: How does a blog post get translated?
items.answer: Name the file with a locale suffix, for example getting-started.zh.mdx next to getting-started.en.mdx. Both share a slug and are linked as hreflang alternates.

items.question: Where do I deploy?
items.answer: The build targets Cloudflare Pages through Nitro. Update wrangler.toml and your site URL before deploying.

cta.title: Start from a working baseline
cta.description: Fork the repository, keep the parts you need, and delete the rest. The landing page, blog, and locale plumbing are already in place.
